summary: Miller calls himself "a proud Jewish American and a staunch defender of Israel" and identifies as "Jewish and pro-Israel." He voted Yea on H.R. 6090, the Antisemitism Awareness Act, in May 2024 and co-led its reintroduction in February 2025, directing federal education-discrimination enforcement to adopt the IHRA definition. Vote for Peace opposes his general-election bid.
